intro_en: You will learn the words for Mongolian wrestling and how to describe rules and customs with passive verbs like нэрлэгдэх. You will also practice following a match with a family member.
intro_mn: Та монгол бөхийн барилдааны үгсийг сурч, нэрлэгдэх, зарлагдах, шалгагдах зэрэг үйлдэгдэх хэвийн үйл үгээр дүрэм, ёс заншлыг тайлбарлаж сурна. Мөн гэр бүлийнхэнтэйгээ барилдаан үзэхэд хэрэгтэй үгсийг дадлагажина.

vocab.example_en: My uncle is a famous wrestler.

vocab.example_mn: Бөх зодгоо өмсөөд талбай руу гарлаа.
vocab.example_en: The wrestler put on his zodog and went out to the field.
He received the title of champion.

vocab.example_mn: Наадамд түрүүлсэн бөх арслан цол авдаг.
vocab.example_en: The wrestler who wins at Naadam receives the title of arslan.
That wrestler holds the title of zaan.

vocab.example_mn: Тэр хоёр дахь тойрогт өрсөлдөгчөө давлаа.
vocab.example_en: He defeated his opponent in the second round.

vocab.example_mn: Бөхийн өвдөг газарт хүрвэл унасанд тооцогддог.
vocab.example_en: If a wrestler's knee touches the ground, it is counted as a fall.

vocab.example_mn: Ялсан бөх дэвж, гараа далавч мэт дэлгэнэ.
vocab.example_en: The winning wrestler does the eagle dance, spreading his arms like wings.

sentences.en: The winning wrestler is called an arslan.
alt_en: A winning wrestler is called a lion.

sentences.en: It is said that nine rounds are wrestled at Naadam.
alt_mn: Наадамд есөн даваа барилддаг гэж ярьдаг.
alt_en: It is said that there are nine rounds at Naadam.

sentences.mn: Бөх бүр барилдахынхаа өмнө зодог шуудгаа шалгуулдаг.
sentences.en: Before wrestling, every wrestler has his zodog and shuudag checked.
alt_mn: Бөх бүрийн зодог шуудаг барилдахаас өмнө шалгагддаг.
alt_en: Every wrestler's zodog and shuudag are checked before the match.
sentences.mn_latin: Bökh bür barildakhynkhaa ömnö zodog shuudgaa shalguuldag.

sentences.mn: Өвдөг газарт хүрвэл бөх унасанд тооцогддог.
sentences.en: If the knee touches the ground, the wrestler is counted as having fallen.
alt_en: If a knee touches the ground, the wrestler is considered to have lost.
sentences.mn_latin: Övdög gazart khürvel bökh unasand tootsogddog.

sentences.mn: Өвөө маань тэр бөхийг заан гэдгийг мэднэ.
sentences.en: My grandfather knows that wrestler is a zaan.
sentences.mn_latin: Övöö maani ter bökhiig zaan gedgiig medne.

sentences.mn: Ялсан бөх дэвж, дараа нь тугийг тойрно.
sentences.en: The winning wrestler does the eagle dance and then circles the ceremonial banner.
sentences.mn_latin: Yalsan bökh devj, daraa ni tugiig toirno.

sentences.mn: Аварга цол хамгийн дээд цол гэж үздэг.
sentences.en: The title of champion is considered the highest title.
alt_mn: Аварга цол хамгийн өндөр цол гэж тооцогддог.
alt_en: Avarga is regarded as the highest title.
sentences.mn_latin: Avarga tsol khamgiin deed tsol gej üzdeg.

sentences.mn: Эгч маань бөхийн барилдааныг телевизээр үздэг.
sentences.en: My older sister watches the wrestling matches on TV.
sentences.mn_latin: Egch maani bökhiin barildaanyg tyelyevizeer üzdeg.

sentences.mn: Тэр бөх гурав дахь тойрогт өрсөлдөгчөө давлаа.
sentences.en: That wrestler beat his opponent in the third round.
alt_mn: Тэр бөх гурав дахь даваанд өрсөлдөгчөө ялсан.
alt_en: That wrestler defeated his opponent in round three.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter bökh gurav dakhi toirogt örsöldögchöö davlaa.

sentences.mn: Барилдаан ихэвчлэн Наадмын хоёр дахь өдөр дуусдаг.
sentences.en: The wrestling usually ends on the second day of Naadam.
sentences.mn_latin: Barildaan ikhevchlen Naadmyn khoyor dakhi ödör duusdag.

sentences.mn: Зодог нь өвөрмөц хэлбэртэй учраас шууд танигддаг.
sentences.en: The zodog is recognized right away because of its unique shape.
alt_mn: Зодог өвөрмөц хэлбэртэй тул шууд таних боломжтой.
alt_en: Because of its distinctive shape, the zodog is easy to recognize.
sentences.mn_latin: Zodog ni övörmöts khelbertei uchraas shuud tanigddag.

sentences.mn: Дүрмийг барилдаан эхлэхээс өмнө дахин мэдэгдэнэ.
sentences.en: The rules are announced again before the match begins.
alt_en: The rules are announced once more before the matches start.
sentences.mn_latin: Dürmiig barildaan ekhlekhees ömnö dakhin medegdene.

grammar.explain_en: In Mongolian, the passive suffix -гд- (also -д-, -т-, depending on the stem) turns a verb into one where the subject receives the action: нэрлэх 'to name' → нэрлэгдэх 'to be called'; зарлах 'to announce' → зарлагдах 'to be announced'; шалгах 'to check' → шалгагдах 'to be checked'. Add the habitual ending -даг/-дэг to talk about rules and customs: 'Ялагч бөх арслан гэж нэрлэгддэг.' The doer is usually left out. This is just like English 'is called', 'is checked'.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд үйлдэгдэх хэв нь 'to be + үйл үгийн 3-р хэлбэр' бүтэцтэй: is called, is checked, is known. Монгол хэлэнд -гд- нөхцөлөөр үүсгэсэн үйл үгтэй адил: нэрлэгддэг = is called. Дүрэм, заншлыг ярихад одоо цагийн хэлбэрийг хэрэглэнэ: 'The winner is called an arslan.' Үйлдэгчийг ихэвчлэн дурдахгүй; хэрэв дурдвал 'by' ашиглана: 'checked by a judge'.

examples.en: The winning wrestler is called an arslan.
The rules are announced before the match.

examples.mn: Энэ цол маш өндөр гэж үнэлэгддэг.
examples.en: This title is valued very highly.
examples.mn_latin: Ene tsol mash öndör gej ünelegddeg.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Нагац ах аа, тэр бөх хэн бэ? Маш өндөр харагдаж байна.
dialogue.en: Uncle, who is that wrestler? He looks very tall.
dialogue.mn_latin: Nagats akh aa, ter bökh khen be? Mash öndör kharagdaj baina.

dialogue.speaker: Nagats
dialogue.mn: Тэр заан цолтой бөх. Энэ жил арслан болох байх.
dialogue.en: He holds the title of zaan. He'll probably become an arslan this year.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ter zaan tsoltoi bökh. Ene jil arslan bolokh baikh.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.en: How do you get a title?

dialogue.speaker: Nagats
dialogue.mn: Тодорхой тойрог хүртэл дараалан ялбал цол авдаг. Наадамд түрүүлсэн бөх арслан гэж нэрлэгддэг.
dialogue.en: If you keep winning up to a certain round, you get a title. The wrestler who wins Naadam is called an arslan.
dialogue.mn_latin: Todorkhoi toirog khürtel daraalan yalbal tsol avdag. Naadamd türüülsen bökh arslan gej nerlegddeg.

dialogue.speaker: Nagats
dialogue.mn: Есөн тойрог. Өвдөг газарт хүрвэл унасанд тооцогддог.
dialogue.en: Nine rounds. If a knee touches the ground, it is counted as a fall.
dialogue.mn_latin: Yesön toirog. Övdög gazart khürvel unasand tootsogddog.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.en: Look, the winning wrestler is doing the eagle dance!

dialogue.speaker: Nagats
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ, энэ бол уламжлал. Үзэсгэлэнтэй биз?
dialogue.en: Yes, that is the tradition. Beautiful, isn't it?
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee, ene bol ulamjlal. Üzesgelentei biz?

culture_note.en: Mongolian wrestling (бөх) is the most respected of the Three Manly Games. Naadam wrestling usually has nine rounds. Titles such as zaan and arslan are earned by winning rounds, and a wrestler who wins Naadam twice becomes an avarga. The winner does the eagle dance, called devekh, and the special zodog and shuudag are part of the tradition.
culture_note.mn: Монгол бөх нь эрийн гурван наадмын хамгийн хүндтэй нь юм. Наадмын барилдаан ихэвчлэн есөн тойрогтой. Заан, арслан зэрэг цолыг даваа ахиж ялснаар олгодог бөгөөд Наадамд хоёр удаа түрүүлсэн бөх аварга болдог. Ялсан бөх бүргэд шиг дэвдэг бөгөөд зодог, шуудаг нь уламжлалын чухал хэсэг юм.

review.notes: Many errors in titles/facts, made-up phrases and fill-in answers; needs substantial revision.

opus_fix.notes: Fixed wrong title facts (arslan/avarga), wrong words (дэнс, галуу, мэдэгдэх as 'be announced') and matched the en/mn culture notes.

changes.why: мэдэгдэх does not mean 'be announced'; use зарлагдах
A first-time Naadam winner gets arslan, not avarga; the example should also use the headword
галуу means goose, not eagle; also matches 'spreading his arms like wings'
'гэж мэдэгддэг' does not mean 'it is said'
дэнс means scale; the banner is туг
мэдэгдэх does not mean 'be announced'; removed the self-contradictory 'if mentioned'
шалгуулдаг (causative) is wrong for an object
A zaan who wins becomes an arslan, not an avarga
Titles come from reaching certain rounds; the winner is called arslan
Fact correction; replaced the Latin 'devekh' in the Mongolian text
